basics.name: Brady Kelly
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary:
I am a highly experienced and proficient C#/.NET full-stack engineer with 25 years of experience in C# and ASP.NET, and other development tools and languages.

 I have excellent problem-solving and analysis skills, with above-average design, implementation, and troubleshooting capabilities, with back and front-end tooling.

I am a team player with exceptionally good communications skills, and a strong affinity for technical writing. 

I like to also engage with stakeholders outside of just the software development arena and learn about the business domains I work in.

A special interest in code quality assurance throughout the entire SDLC, and the use of automated and other tooling to identify potential code quality issues, set me apart from many other engineers.

work.name: Contactable
work.summary: Development and maintenance on a large digital identity orchestration platform
highlights: Development and maintenance on a large and complex network of controller based ASP.NET REST APIs.
Development of Postman collections to test ASP.NET REST APIs, as well as Postman environments to provide suitable test values for endpoints.
Using Postman single queries and collection runs to test from single to many API endpoints.

Maintenance on complex, multi-project startup configurations that allowed APIs to run simultaneously on a local machine versus GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine). Many APIs depended on others being available, which sometimes made this task quite complex.
Debugging of complex problems that sometimes involved external service provider APIs outside of our control.
Deployment of ASP.NET APIs to GKE
Administration and querying of several Cassandra databases hosted locally on Docker or on GKE.

work.name: LexisNexis
work.summary: Development and maintenance on several Angular based micro-frontend applications
highlights: Development of new features on a large and complex product that comprises multiple services, micro-services, and micro-frontends, hosted on AWS and Azure cloud infrastructures.
Maintenance and development on Angular components and services for micro-frontend client applications
Maintenance and development on ASP.NET REST API backend for frontend (BFF) applications, also known as feature peers.
Complex debugging of Angular client applications that required multiple back and front-end components running simultaneously on production, QA, and local machine environments.
